answer: Past the inlet, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Standing rots without use: identities must re-validate with new graded work every few epochs or lose their earning rate. Under the kernel, a clone army is a maintenance burden — every fake needs feeding with fresh work, and the farm's upkeep bill grows with the size of its herd. Hold the ember steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
